title: Voice Transcript Schema
description: Structure for a single question-answer turn captured during an AI voice screening call, and the ordered session transcript that groups turns together.

transcript_id.description: Unique transcript turn identifier. Format: TR-<session date YYYYMMDD>-<4 digit sequence>.

candidate_id.description: Foreign key to the candidate record.

job_id.description: Foreign key to the job/role being screened for.

session_id.description: Foreign key to the parent screening session.

question_id.description: Matches the id field of the source question object in hr_screening_questions.json, e.g. skill_002.

turn_index.description: Zero-based position of this turn within the session, defines playback and review order.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp marking when the candidate's response was captured, e.g. 2026-09-04T10:15:32Z.

speaker.description: Who produced this transcript line. Only candidate turns carry extracted_value.

raw_transcript.description: Unmodified speech-to-text output, including filler words and disfluencies.

normalized_transcript.description: Transcript after normalization rules are applied. See normalization_rules.json.

confidence_level.description: STT engine confidence score for this turn. Bands: high >= 0.85, medium 0.60-0.84, low < 0.60.

answer_type.description: Copied from the source question object; governs how extracted_value is parsed.

extract_field.description: Copied from the source question object; the field this answer is written to in the candidate's screening record.

extracted_value.description: Parsed value derived from normalized_transcript according to answer_type. Null if extraction failed or the turn is an AI prompt.

language.description: BCP-47 language code of the spoken response.

audio_duration_seconds.description: Length of the audio segment this turn was transcribed from.

retry_count.description: Number of times the AI re-prompted this question before this turn was accepted.

flagged_for_review.description: Set true when confidence_level is low and mandatory is true on the source question, so a recruiter can manually verify the answer.
